points.quote: `IDisposable` is the base interface. Subscribing to an `Event` returns an `IDisposable`, and disposing it removes the listener.
A subclass calls `this._register(x)` on anything it creates, and everything registered is disposed when the owner is. ... `Disposable` uses one internally.
`DisposableStore` is a bag of disposables that you `add` to and `dispose` together. ... `toDisposable(fn)` wraps a cleanup callback
`MutableDisposable` holds a single value. Assigning a new value disposes the old one.
`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` in `src/vs/base/test/common/utils.ts` is called inside a test suite. ... it fails the suite if any tracked disposable is left undisposed.
